text: • Composite Master Key To open a database you must use all key sources such as password, key file and/or Windows account details that were used when the Master Key was created.
KeePass should run on Operating Systems: WINE, 32-bit MS Windows (95/98), 32-bit MS Windows (NT/2000/XP), All 32-bit MS Windows (95/98/NT/2000/XP),Win2K, WinXP, Microsoft Windows Server
It is the first thing a user must do to begin using KeePass.
REQ-1: KeePass must be downloaded and installed REQ-2: Master Password has no limits in length.
REQ-3: Folder selected must be of type the database can read and that is “name”.kdb
REQ-4: Databases must have different names or else the previews one will be replace if selected
REQ-5: There must be entries in the database in order for them to be printed
REQ-6: All data related to the word must be shown.
For example if user types “abc” and abc is part of a password and of a username, b oth entries must be shown
When creating a group/subgroup the user must select a name and then he can add entries into it.
In order for that to happen, he must have chosen first a group/subgroup.
REQ-10: In order to find something in a group a word must be placed in the find field
A message appears “the repeated password must be identical with the password
REQ-11: An entry must belong to a group to be created REQ-12: When the password field is completed t he repeat password field must be completed
REQ-13: Password field and repeat password field must be identical
In order for that to happen, the user must select an entry first.
REQ-14: An entry must be selected to be viewed or modified REQ-15: When the password field is changed the repeat password field must be Changed and be identical with password f ield
REQ-16: An entry must be selected before it is duplicated
REQ-17: An entry must be selected to be deleted
The sequence must be prefixed with “Auto-Type” and length of one line.

REQ-19: The prefix “Auto-Type:” is required in front of each sequence REQ-20: Sequence’s length must not be more than a line (59 characters) REQ-21: If two auto-types are referred in one note field, only the first is used
REQ-22: Only one database file is allowed in command line options REQ-23: In case a space is found in the path, it must be enclosed into quotes
But the same composition of them must be used always.

REQ-24: If a master password is required to unlock the database, the database doesn’t open unless the password is entered REQ-25: If a key file is required to unlock the database, the database doesn’t open unless The key file is present REQ-26: If there is a composite key, both master password and key file are required REQ-27: In case of lost master password or key file, the database never unlocks again.
If in the meanwhile it is not pasted anywhere, it must be copied again.
